analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 27 Oct 2026
key_insights: Markets rebounded at midday led by tech as the AI trade showed signs of stabilizing after last week's degrossing episode. NDX +130bps (reclaiming its 100DMA), R2K +81bps, SPX +67bps.
Breadth was weaker: 286 names down on the day and SPX ex AI -50bps.
AI complex outperformed: neoclouds GSXUNEOC +585bps, optical GSXUOPTI +5%, inference chips GSXUINFR +466bps, memory GSTMTMEM +368bp, semis GSCBSMHX +3%.
The long software short semis pair worked 'the right way', with GSPUSOSE -414bps.

The GS tech desk (TY Bartlett) attributes AI strength to three factors: easing of the 'AI financing concern' narrative after a successful META offering and an AVGO funding story overnight, anticipation of hyperscaler earnings and capex (GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN all report this week), and better EPS overnight (CLS +15%) with the trade bouncing off oversold conditions as high-velocity selling eased.
The momentum factor is recovering after a ~20% drawdown over the last few weeks. GSPRHIMO high beta momentum +272bps and up ~8% over the last 3 sessions.
The GS PB team says Global fundamental L/S momentum exposure is near YTD lows after the degrossing episode.
The GS hedge fund positioning pair is stabilizing, GSTHVIPP +110bps, but is still down -10.5% MTD.
Liquidity is stable: overall market volumes are down 7%, ETFs are 27% of the tape (slightly below the YTD average), and top of book liquidity improved to $12.2m, up 25% from the 5DMA.

GS flows: desk is 3 out of 10 across the floor and better for sale with a 1% sell skew. Long-only clients are better for sale, with supply in info comms services and macro products against demand in tech and consumer discretionary. Hedge funds are 10% better to buy on lighter notional, with demand in comm services, tech and financials against light supply in consumer discretionary and macro products.
earnings_insights: CLS shares +15% on better EPS reported overnight (no figures given in the note).
GOOGL, MSFT and AMZN all report earnings this week, and the desk flags anticipation of hyperscaler earnings and capex as a driver of AI strength.
risk_factors: Market breadth remains weak: 286 names down and SPX ex AI -50bps, so the rebound is concentrated in AI.
The AI financing concern narrative eased but is cited as a driver of the prior selloff and could return.
